segments.sn22.151:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa –
segments.sn22.151:1.3: ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassatī”ti?
segments.sn22.151:1.4: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā … pe …“rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa … pe … viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa –
segments.sn22.151:1.7: ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.sn22.151:1.8: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.151:1.10: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attāti samanupasseyyāti?
segments.sn22.151:1.13: “Vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.151:1.17: “Aniccaṃ bhante”… pe … vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attāti samanupasseyyāti?
